verdict.rationale: Patent Center documents that direct API callers to Workbench/view applications had to move to a new 'version level of the APIs', which shows the APIs are versioned. A real API endpoint exists at api.uspto.gov. No deprecation policy, support windows, or sunset timelines for APIs appear in the evidence (the TEAS form retirements concern web forms, not APIs). missing for 10: a documented API deprecation policy, a documented versioning scheme and changelog, readable developer docs (the portal is a JS shell with no OpenAPI spec), and independent corroboration.
